texts.sv_au_denied: Nyirabyo, umugenzuzi cyangwa umucungamari ni bo bonyine bashobora gufungura igenzura.
texts.sv_au_intro: Buri gikorwa cy'iyi konti. Buri gihe uru rupapuro rurebwe birandikwa.
texts.sv_bin_intro: Ibyasibwe bimara hano iminsi {days}, hanyuma bikavanwaho burundu.
texts.sv_bin_never: Inyemezabuguzi zatanzwe, inyandiko z'inguzanyo, ibyanditswe mu bitabo, ubwishyu, amajwi, inyandiko zasinywe n'ibiri mu irinda ry'amategeko ntibisibwa na rimwe.
texts.sv_cal_intro: Amatariki ya buri serivisi ahantu hamwe. Gutumiza, ikiruhuko, imirimo, amasaha y'akazi, ubukode n'amafaranga y'ishuri bizongerwaho serivisi zabyo nizigera.
texts.sv_cs_links_help: Iyi miyoboro ikeneye uruhushya rwawe. Uzimije umwe, buri serivisi ihita ireka kuwukoresha.
texts.sv_cs_shared_help: Ubona amakuru yawe, ibyo abona n'igihe kugeza ryari.
texts.sv_ct_intro: Urutonde rumwe kuri buri serivisi. Amazina n'aho umuntu abonekera bibikwa mu bubiko burinzwe.
texts.sv_owner_only: Nyirabyo wenyine ni we ushobora kubihindura.
texts.sv_pl_intro: Buri gahunda n'imbibi zayo, n'ibimaze gukoreshwa.
texts.sv_tc_intro: Gerageza imiyoboro n'ibikora byonyine nta mpungenge: amakuru y'urugero, buri mufatanyabikorwa mu igerageza, nta butumwa bwoherejwe kandi nta mafaranga yimuwe.
texts.sv_tc_on: Kopi y'igerageza irafunguye. Ubutumwa ku bakiriya burafunze hano.
